svg.text: Pareto front per ride limit R: owned minibuses vs borrowed vehicle-hours per week
Bubble size grows with peak borrowed vehicles on the busiest day (f2). Solid = non-dominated on (f1, f2, f3); faint = dominated. Dashed line joins the non-dominated points of that R (visual guide).
Labels: A = minibuses only; S/V/H + L = owned minibuses with sedans / minivans / day-level hybrid. Infeasible options are not drawn.
V: minibuses + minivans (3 seats, max 1 Sw)
